caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels Mollamide B as Antimicrobial/Anticancer. Primary paper supports anticancer/cytotoxicity, antimalarial, antileishmanial, and anti-HIV values, but explicitly reports no activity in the named MRSA/Mycobacterium/fungal antimicrobial screen.

Primary source supports modified cyclic Mollamide B residue order, thiazoline, reverse-prenylated threonine, and stereochemistry; DRAMP sequence TPFVXV is a simplified code and does not fully encode modifications/cyclic termini.
